scope_notes: Synthetic or public reference dates only; no real user birth profile submitted.
No authenticated official API or commercial API was called.
This artifact does not establish predictive validity of fortune-telling.
Engine and source versions are pinned; future upgrades require new comparison.

solar_term_probe.scope: Research probe only: 48 events in 1993 and 2026; no saju-pillar validation; no authenticated vendor/API call.
limitations: KASI source reports rounded minutes, not exact seconds.
Counts and rounded-minute matches do not prove all years or all policy boundaries correct.
KASI original physical ephemeris lineage is not established; numerical agreement alone is not proof of independent validation.
Astronomy Engine default UTC approximations and Delta-T model differ from Skyfield time-scale handling.
Future UTC/leap-second assumptions can change; preserve time-scale versions and original source precision.

source.kasi_source_clock: fixed UTC+09:00, irrespective of historical Korea offset or DST

solar_term_probe.note_on_source_values: The full KASI source is linked, not republished here. Deltas reference its rounded minute display. Computed engine timestamps preserve microseconds but do not imply microsecond physical accuracy.

manseryeok_probe.method: Imported fixed public npm package ESM; install/build scripts were not executed; no correction applied to birth wall time.
manseryeok_probe.expectedRule: Proposed comparison rule: year changes at Li Chun instant, month at each of 12 Jie instants. KASI values are minute-rounded KST; fixture inputs are at least 12 minutes away from boundary. This tests deterministic calendar boundaries, not predictive validity of fortune-telling.

reference.clock: KST UTC+9 fixed; no historical DST/meridian changes; source header dated 2026-09-01

korean_chinese_probe.method: Executed source checkouts at recorded commits; no install scripts; no network calls during calculations. Cross-library comparison is not itself independent official verification.

korean_chinese_probe.notes: 6tail raw Solar wall inputs have no IANA timezone field. ShouXingUtil.qiAccurate adds 1/3 day (=UTC+8). Converting KST to UTC+8 repairs instant comparison but blindly shifting all four-pillar civil inputs may move the day/hour boundary. Korean solar/lunar conversion and day/hour rules require separate adapters.
